notes: Both new plates were authorized by the 2024 'license plate bill to end license plate bills' (SB 95, passed Aug 2024; also moves future specialty plates to a DMV application process); exact first-issue date not found, likely 2025. The same law authorized women-veteran and retired-women-veteran plates, but they are not on the DMV page yet. 'Supporting the Arts' (in game) no longer appears on the DMV list, only 'Celebrating the Arts' (fireweed) — unconfirmed whether retired or a duplicate name. The UAS image is named uaa-se2025.jpg, a possible 2025 redesign, unconfirmed. The DMV also lists 'Unit Designator' plates (60+ unit insignia) not in the game; the program predates 2023 so it is not listed as new.
